facts.en: Completed a BA in Media Administration at Fictional Institute D069 in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构院校 D069 完成媒体行政文学学士学位。

facts.en: Worked as a delivery coordination assistant at Fictional Digital Studio D069 from 2022-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-01 至 2026-08 在虚构数字工作室 D069 担任交付协调助理。

facts.en: Maintained task boards, meeting actions and dependency lists for client website updates.
facts.zh: 为客户网站更新维护任务看板、会议行动及依赖清单。

facts.en: Used a project tracker to record owners and deadlines; designers and developers estimated and executed their own work.
facts.zh: 使用项目跟踪工具记录负责人及截止日期；设计师和开发者估算并执行各自工作。

facts.en: Coordinated review invitations and approval records for a 2025-09 website release containing 24 revised pages.
facts.zh: 为 2025-09 一次包含 24 个修订页面的网站发布协调审查邀请及审批记录。

facts.en: A team of 5 delivered those 24 pages; the candidate maintained coordination records and did not design, code or author all pages.
facts.zh: 一个 5 人团队交付这 24 个页面；候选人维护协调记录，未设计、编码或撰写全部页面。

facts.en: With a quality analyst, introduced an approval-evidence field in the release checklist during 2025-10.
facts.zh: 在 2025-10 与质量分析师合作，在发布清单引入审批证据字段。

facts.en: Across 12 review packets in 2025-Q4, 2 lacked approval evidence at handover versus 5 of 12 in 2025-Q3; reviewers and project leads shared implementation.
facts.zh: 在 2025-Q4 的 12 份审查资料中，2 份在交接时缺少审批证据；2025-Q3 的 12 份中为 5 份；审核者与项目负责人共同实施改进。

facts.en: Prepared client status drafts for project-manager approval and escalated blocked dependencies.
facts.zh: 准备供项目经理审批的客户状态草稿，并上报受阻依赖。

facts.en: Drafted an automated reminder workflow in 2026-04; a developer reviewed feasibility but no automation was shipped.
facts.zh: 2026-04 起草自动提醒流程；开发者审查可行性，但未发布自动化。

facts.en: Supported a peak of 6 concurrent update streams in 2025-11; the normal 2026-08 assignment was 3.
facts.zh: 在 2025-11 高峰期支持 6 个并行更新工作流；2026-08 常规分工为 3 个。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Film Circle V069 on evenings from 2023-03 to 2023-08 while employed, scheduling screenings.
facts.zh: 2023-03 至 2023-08 任职期间，晚间在虚构电影社团 V069 志愿安排放映。

facts.en: Created a personal stop-motion clip using paper shapes; it was not client production work.
facts.zh: 使用纸形制作个人定格动画短片；并非客户制作工作。

facts.en: Keeps a recreational fountain-pen ink comparison journal unrelated to digital delivery.
facts.zh: 保留与数字交付无关的休闲钢笔墨水比较日记。

facts.en: Documented decisions without treating meeting attendance as approval or assuming unassigned tasks were complete.
facts.zh: 记录决策，不将出席会议视为批准，也不假定未分配任务已完成。

facts.en: A portfolio caption says independently launched 24 pages, contradicting the team delivery record and the candidate’s coordination-only remit.
facts.zh: 作品集图注称独立发布 24 个页面，与团队交付记录及候选人仅协调的职责冲突。

facts.en: No software deployment permissions, visual-design ownership or formal line-management authority is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录软件部署权限、视觉设计负责或正式直属管理权限。

facts.en: Collected timesheet completion confirmations but did not set project fees or approve overtime.
facts.zh: 收集工时表完成确认，但不设定项目费用或批准加班。
